platform.a: In the ERA ecosystem, identity, subscriptions, and industry modules are unified through the ERA 365 control plane and Finance ERP.

sso.q: How do I sign in with SSO?
sso.a: Open this module from ERA Finance or ERA 365 Orchestrator — the token is passed automatically.

register.q: Where do I register an organization?
register.a: After first sign-in use Organization registration in Orchestrator or app.era-365.online with VÖEN.

mdm.title: MDM
mdm.subtitle: Master data: legal entities and person identity across the platform.
mdm.companiesHint: Registered legal entities (VÖEN) and their org links.
mdm.personsHint: Directory, filters, resolve/create and merge duplicates.

mdmPersons.title: MDM — persons
mdmPersons.hint: Super-admin directory: list, filter, resolve/create, merge duplicates. PII decrypted for platform operators only.
mdmPersons.mergeHint: Source (duplicate) is folded into target (canonical). Source disappears from the main list.
mdmPersons.mergeConfirm: Merge these persons? This cannot be undone from the UI.

mdmCompanies.title: MDM — companies
mdmCompanies.hint: Legal names are encrypted at rest (PII). If decryption fails, the orchestrator organization name is shown; VÖEN is never shown in clear text here.
mdmCompanies.linkHint: Lookup MDM by VÖEN, then link to an organization UUID.
mdmCompanies.lookupNotFound: Not found — fill name and link
mdmCompanies.linkRequired: Org UUID, name and VÖEN required

billingSettings.title: Billing settings

billingSettings.foundationHint: Base platform fee billed after trial for every organization.
billingSettings.bankingFoundationHint: Billed only when industry_banking is connected.
billingSettings.yearlyDiscountHint: Discount applied when the customer pays annually.
billingSettings.trialPeriodDaysHint: Applies only to new SHARED organizations. DEDICATED/ONPREM start with no trial (perpetual until super-admin sets a date). Existing orgs keep their snapshotted expiry.

billingPackages.title: Packages

billingQuotas.title: Quotas & tier pricing
billingQuotas.subtitle: Per-tier included limits, tier price, spend ceiling, and overlimit unit prices.
billingQuotas.matrixHint: Included limits and price per tier. Empty limit = unlimited.
billingQuotas.unlimitedHint: Empty cell = unlimited (∞). OCR overlimit uses meter unit price per page.
billingQuotas.unitPricingHint: Charged when usage exceeds the tier included amount.

trialAllowlist.title: Trial: allowed modules

orgs.title: Organizations

orgHub.title: Organization hub
orgHub.detachConfirm: Detach this organization from its parent (DEPARTMENT → STANDALONE)? Routing becomes OWN.
orgHub.endpointsHint: After saving enabled base URLs, use Sync satellite bindings to push this org (or matching department) UUID into each satellite. See ADR satellite-organization-bind.
orgHub.bridgeHint: Per-org dual-run policy. Save then Sync so hotel upserts the row for this organizationId — not process-wide env.
orgHub.cutoverHint: Extras still route to Elektraweb via the linked hotel org during cutover. Hour X: turn dual-run off for this clinic org only.
orgHub.syncEmpty: No enabled industry endpoints to sync — save hotel/fnb/clinic URLs first

organizations.title: Your organizations
organizations.subtitle: Switch workspace or create a new legal entity
organizations.emptyHint: Register with company name and VÖEN to open the module workspace.
organizations.createHint: Separate legal entity with its own VÖEN and subscription.
organizations.pickSubtitle: You belong to several companies — pick the one to work in.
organizations.invitedHint: Waiting for an invitation? If you were invited to manage another company as an accountant, the company will appear here once its owner adds you.
organizations.invitesSubtitle: You have been invited to manage these companies. Accept to enter.
organizations.joinHint: Sends an access request to the organization owners.
organizations.joinOk: Access request sent — wait for owner approval.

holdings.title: Holdings
holdings.subtitle: Group legal entities for consolidated reporting in Finance
holdings.createHint: You become the holding owner. Attach organizations you own, then grant report access to others.
holdings.name: Holding name
holdings.emptyHint: Create a holding to group companies for consolidated P&L and cash dashboards.
holdings.deleteConfirm: Soft-delete this holding? Organizations will be unlinked.
holdings.membersEmpty: No members yet. Owner always has full access.
holdings.commercialLinkHint: Link a commercial org to a workforce scope (UUID).

workspace.addSatelliteSubtitle: Connect any ERA satellite to this company. Billing starts when you enable its modules.

modulesModal.title: {system} — modules
modulesModal.subtitle: Enable or disable billable modules for this satellite.
modulesModal.empty: This satellite has no add-on modules. Its feature scope (e.g. presets) is configured inside the satellite after you open it.
modulesModal.disableBillingNotice: Module stays billable for the current month; access ends at month end.
modulesModal.connectFailed: Could not connect satellite — try again or contact support.
modulesModal.billingFootnote: Disabled modules remain on the current month's invoice (post-paid billing).

team.transferHint: Owner only. New owner must already be a member.

subscription.readOnlyBanner: Trial expired — workspace is read-only until you renew.
subscription.noModules: No modules connected yet. Add satellites and modules from the workspace.
subscription.trialHint: Connect satellites on the workspace; ops extends trial in super-admin org subscription.
subscription.billingConstructorHint: Owner tools: plan, bundles, premium unlock, checkout (gateway may be mock).

terms.intro: Terms of use for the ERA 365 platform.
terms.section1Body: ERA 365 is a cloud ERP ecosystem. The service is provided by subscription and selected modules.
terms.section2Body: Organization data is encrypted and processed only with your permission.

partner.title: Partner dashboard
partner.loginRequired: Sign in to access the partner dashboard

personAccess.title: Personal data access consent
personAccess.subtitle: Organizations below requested access to your identity data. Grant or deny each request.
personAccess.needToken: Open this page from your guest QR link (era://guest/…) or hotel check-in portal.
personAccess.invalidToken: Invalid or expired link. Ask reception for a new QR code.
personAccess.sessionExpired: Session expired. Scan your guest QR again.
personAccess.decideFailed: Could not save your choice. Try again.

workforceGate.title: Workforce is not enabled
workforceGate.hint: The Workforce hub (hiring, org structure, absences, HR security) is a billable module — Kadr Mərkəzi. Enable it to start managing staff.

workforceEmployments.title: Workforce — employments
workforceEmployments.subtitle: CP hire anchor (MDM person + org unit + position).
workforceEmployments.gateHint: The Workforce hub (hiring, org structure, absences, HR security) is a billable module. Enable it to start managing staff.
workforceEmployments.mdmHint: Resolve person in MDM first; bootstrap org structure if empty. Seat is optional — leave satellites unchecked for headcount-only staff.
workforceEmployments.bootstrapHint: Workforce scope not initialized. Bootstrap creates scope + root org unit.
workforceEmployments.satelliteAccessHint: Tick a satellite only when this person needs a login there. Cleaner, kitchen, and security are employment without a seat. Empty boxes = headcount only.
workforceEmployments.hireSubtitle: Resolve person in MDM, then assign org unit and position. Satellite login is optional.
workforceEmployments.reprovisionConfirm: Re-emit satellite access (STAFF_PROVISIONED) for active bindings?
workforceEmployments.reprovisionNoBindings: No active satellite bindings. Grant Hotel/Clinic/F&B access first.
workforceEmployments.bloodOptionalHint: Optional — can be filled later on the employee card (personal file / Aktiv list).
workforceEmployments.cardSubtitle: MDM identity and CP employment assignment.
workforceEmployments.cardSatellitesHint: satellite login seats are managed under Access & security.

workforceSecurity.title: Access & security — role matrix
workforceSecurity.subtitle: HR seats and default satellite roles per position.
workforceSecurity.matrixHint: Roles assigned automatically by position. Choose “No access” to clear.
workforceSecurity.bindingsPageSubtitle: Roles currently provisioned to satellite staff accounts.
workforceSecurity.grantsPageSubtitle: One-off satellite access outside the position matrix.
workforceSecurity.noPositions: No positions yet — add positions to configure roles.
workforceSecurity.fieldEmploymentHint: Search by name. Label is name — position · unit.

workforceExport.title: Workforce — export / import
workforceExport.subtitle: Download CSV for payroll (1C) or import roster and absences (xlsx or CSV).
workforceExport.rosterHint: Staff codes, org unit, position, hire date
workforceExport.importRosterHint: Columns: fin, fullName, sex, birthDate, orgUnit, position, hireDate, workplace, satellites. Empty satellites = employment without a seat (cleaner/kitchen/security). workplace ADDITIONAL = second job, no seat. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD (Excel serials and DD.MM.YYYY are converted). Import org-structure first.
workforceExport.importAbsencesHint: CSV/xlsx: staffCode or globalPersonId, kind, startDate, endDate[,note]. Take staffCode from roster export.
workforceExport.fileNone: No file yet — use sample, choose xlsx/csv, or paste CSV below.
workforceExport.importHowTo: Import buttons stay inactive until a file or CSV is loaded. Click “Load sample into form”, choose xlsx/csv, or paste CSV — then Validate / Apply.
workforceExport.importNeedFile: Load a file or paste CSV first.

workforceAudit.title: Workforce — security audit
workforceAudit.subtitle: CP workforce actions (hire, roles, seats). Satellite ops audit stays separate.

workforceOrg.title: Workforce — org structure
workforceOrg.subtitle: HR org unit tree (commercial org ≠ org unit). Import ştat (xlsx) before the employee roster.
workforceOrg.bootstrapHint: Bootstrap workforce scope to create root org unit.
workforceOrg.importHint: xlsx/csv: orgUnit, position, totalSlots (or Şöbə, Vəzifə, Ştat vahidi). Upsert by name; does not delete extra units. Import this file before the employee roster.
workforceOrg.fileNone: No file yet — choose xlsx/csv or paste CSV.

workforcePositions.title: Workforce — positions
workforcePositions.subtitle: Cadre positions with slot limits per org unit.
workforcePositions.archiveConfirm: Archive position “{name}”? Active employments must be transferred or terminated first.

workforceAbsences.title: Workforce — absences
workforceAbsences.subtitle: Submit and approve leave / sick leave (CP workflow).
workforceAbsences.newSubtitle: Create draft or submit for approval.

workforceTimesheets.title: Timesheets
workforceTimesheets.subtitle: Month grid: attendance codes, autofill, sync approved absences, approve.
workforceTimesheets.confirmApprove: Approve this timesheet? It becomes read-only.
workforceTimesheets.legendHint: Click a cell to cycle the day type. Locked amber cells come from approved absences.
